summary: Compass Digital is the digital and technology innovation arm of Compass Group North America, building digital products and technology for customers and operators.
Compass/SmartQ digital capabilities include mobile ordering, self-service kiosks, intelligent menu displays, scan-and-go, loyalty/rewards and Power BI-based café analytics.
Compass integrates carbon intelligence directly into menu-development, procurement and supply-chain systems, showing centralized enterprise control of food-data workflows.
Compass Group reported 7.3% organic revenue growth in Q1 FY2026 and client retention above 96%.
